name: High Eden

known.via: English Wikipedia "High Eden" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Riesling, Chardonnay, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Syrah, Riesling, Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile. Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
